rows.label: bf06140160_0020
rows.name: Punin-san?! What are you doing here?

rows.label: bf06140160_0030
rows.name: What do you mean, why am I here?

rows.label: bf06140160_0040
rows.name:
I arranged the world-famous cooking group,
the Fire Dragons, mo.

rows.label: bf06140160_0070
rows.name:
Superbia asked me to serve
the finest food possible.

rows.label: bf06140160_0080
rows.name:
I went to desperate lengths to gather them,
and look what you've done, mo!

rows.label: bf06140160_0120
rows.name:
I did think they were not
putting up much of a fight.

rows.label: bf06140160_0140
rows.name:
D-d-d-delicious!
How can it be this good?!

rows.label: bf06140160_0150
rows.name:
What are you going to do about this, mo?
The precious food is ruined, mo!

rows.label: bf06140160_0160
rows.name:
S-sorry! We really did think they
were here to murder someone...

rows.label: bf06140160_0170
rows.name:
Assassins? What nonsense
are you talking about, mo?

rows.label: bf06140160_0190
rows.name:
How much do you think it cost
to gather the chefs and ingredients...

rows.label: bf06140160_0240
rows.name: Queen Lagert had only just arrived!

rows.label: bf06140160_0250
rows.name:
The Queen arrived...
Could it be...?

rows.label: bf06140160_0290
rows.name:
Are you planning to skip out on the bill and run, mo?
Fungo-fungo, mo!
